name: The Sultanate of the Iron Wall

specialRules.name: No special rules
specialRules.text: A standard Iron Sultanate warband has no extra faction rules. Faithful.

abilities.name: Mubarizun
abilities.text: +1 INJURY DICE on its attacks against targets with TOUGH.

abilities.name: Counter-Charge (Janissary Veterans only)
abilities.text: If the first ACTION of the Activation is a Charge, +1 DICE to its Melee Attacks for the rest of the Activation.

sim.cond: first ACTION this Activation was a Charge

upgrades.name: Janissary Veteran
upgrades.text: Gains STRONG and the Counter-Charge ability.

abilities.name: Mastery of the Elements
abilities.text: On first deployment all its weapons gain one of FIRE, GAS or SHRAPNEL (same for all).

abilities.name: Elemental Change ACTION
abilities.text: Risky Success Roll: on success switch the Mastery keyword to one of the other two; on failure Activation ends.

abilities.name: Temporal Assassin
abilities.text: When charging (before any Fight that Activation) it may pick a second target, fight the first, then redeploy within 1" of the second and fight it with the same weapon; no further Fight that Activation.

abilities.name: Time Slip
abilities.text: When an enemy attack against it fails its Success Roll, it may redeploy up to 6" away and more than 1" from enemies (ends a Retreat).

upgrades.name: Light Skirmisher
upgrades.text: Gains the SKIRMISHER Keyword.

models.name: Sultanate Sapper
models.kitRule: always has a Shovel (cannot be removed); otherwise any Iron Sultanate kit

abilities.name: Set Mine ACTION
abilities.text: Touching a terrain piece up to 8"x8": Success Roll with +2 DICE; on success it gains MINED.

abilities.name: Defuse Mine
abilities.text: On touching a MINED marker/terrain, Risky Success Roll to remove MINED; failure detonates it and ends the Activation. Its own mines defuse automatically.

abilities.name: Fortify ACTION
abilities.text: Risky Success Roll: on success has COVER until it moves; on failure Activation ends.

abilities.name: Forward Positions
abilities.text: May deploy up to 6" outside the deployment zone touching terrain at least 1/2" high.

models.name: Lion of Jabir
models.kitRule: Armour and/or Wind Amulet only; no Shields or other kit

abilities.name: Agile
abilities.text: +1 DICE to Risky Success Rolls to Climb, Jump, Diving Charge or Dash.

abilities.name: Artificial Life
abilities.text: Injury Rolls against this model suffer -1 INJURY DICE.

abilities.name: Teeth and Claws
abilities.text: Can make Melee Attacks without a Melee Weapon.

abilities.name: Pin
abilities.text: Down enemies on bases 40mm or less cannot stand up while a Lion is within 1".

upgrades.name: Fearsome
upgrades.text: Gains the FEAR Keyword.

abilities.name: Counter-Charge
abilities.text: If the first ACTION of the Activation is a Charge, +1 DICE to its Melee Attacks for the rest of the Activation.

sim.cond: first ACTION this Activation was a Charge

models.name: Brazen Bull
models.kitRule: weapons must have HEAVY; no Shovel except a Marid Shovel; other kit types unrestricted

abilities.name: Artificial Life
abilities.text: Injury Rolls against this model suffer -1 INJURY DICE.

abilities.name: Trample ACTION
abilities.text: Melee Attack without a weapon against a Down enemy, with IGNORE ARMOUR.

uniqueKit.name: Alaybozan
uniqueKit.text: Sapper blunderbuss; Sultanate Sappers only, Shield Combo.

uniqueKit.name: Alchemical Ammunition
uniqueKit.text: Only works with an Alaybozan, Halberd-Gun, Jezzail or Siege Jezzail (Alaybozan allowed despite SHRAPNEL). Cannot be moved to another model in a campaign.

sim.cond: with Alaybozan, Halberd-Gun, Jezzail or Siege Jezzail

uniqueKit.name: Alchemist Armour
uniqueKit.text: Protection From Harm: FIRE or GAS attacks against the wearer suffer -1 INJURY DICE, even with IGNORE ARMOUR.

uniqueKit.name: Assassin's Dagger
uniqueKit.text: Slashing Attack: if it places at least one BLOOD MARKER the Assassin may Dash to Retreat in the same Activation; when the Assassin Retreats that Activation, enemies within 1" get no free Melee Attack.

uniqueKit.name: Cloak of Alamut
uniqueKit.text: Blend In: the Cover modifier against the wearer is -2 DICE instead of -1 DICE.

uniqueKit.name: Flame Cannon
uniqueKit.text: Greek Fire: no Success Roll; trace a 1mm line up to 12" (stopped by terrain taller than the firer) and make an Injury Roll for every model it touches, friend or foe.

uniqueKit.name: Halberd-Gun
uniqueKit.text: ELITE only.

uniqueKit.name: Marid Shovel
uniqueKit.text: Industrial Tool: Brazen Bull starting on Open terrain has COVER until it moves; can also be used as a Trench Club.

uniqueKit.name: M.U.R.A.D. Bombard
uniqueKit.text: Echoing Blast: the hit or scattered-onto model takes a DEADLY Injury Roll; every other model in the blast is taken Down with no Injury Roll.

uniqueKit.name: Takwin Anqa Bird
uniqueKit.text: Cause Confusion: Melee Attacks against the owner use Risky Success Rolls; an enemy within 1" must pass a Risky Success Roll to Retreat or its Activation ends.

uniqueKit.name: Titan Zulfiqar
uniqueKit.text: Brazen Bull only.

uniqueKit.name: Wind Amulet
uniqueKit.text: Gusts of Wind: once per game, at the start of the model's Activation, +3" Movement for that Activation.

variants.name: Fida'i of Alamut
variants.changes: Assassin cabal: Master Assassin leads, 0-2 Assassins with unique Art of Assassination abilities, 0-4 Dervishes, infiltrating Azeb acolytes, one free Fireteam and Alamut weapons.

specialRules.name: Assassin Acolytes

specialRules.name: Dervishes

specialRules.name: Flock of Assassins

specialRules.name: Killing Squad
specialRules.text: One Fireteam of any 2 models, free.

specialRules.name: Master Assassin
specialRules.text: Must include 1: Sultanate Assassin entry with LEADER and TOUGH, 95 ducats.

abilities.text: If Infiltrators may deploy, may deploy within 1" of any edge more than 8" from enemies.

uniqueKit.name: Anqa Guard
uniqueKit.text: 40mm Impassable wall about 1/2" high: deploy in your zone after the carrier, or via a Combat Deployment ACTION (Risky Success Roll +2 DICE) within 1".

uniqueKit.name: Banner of Desert Wind
uniqueKit.text: Sandstorm: enemies starting an Activation within 24" of the bearer have -1" Movement that Activation, unless the bearer is Down.

uniqueKit.name: Explosive Charges
uniqueKit.text: Secretly plant on a terrain piece up to 8"x8" outside the enemy zone after deployment; any friendly Activation may detonate: SHRAPNEL Injury Roll for every model on/touching it, terrain removed, models on top Fall.

uniqueKit.name: Iron Wall Kalkan
uniqueKit.text: Othismos: on a Move in contact with one enemy on 40mm or smaller base, the Bull may push it straight ahead; pushing into terrain over 1/2" high causes an Injury Roll.

uniqueKit.name: Sultanate Grand Cannon
uniqueKit.text: Carried by a Brazen Bull as a 1-Handed weapon, or a 50mm gun battery fired once per Turn by a friend within 1" that did not move. Unstoppable Object: a target not taken Out of Action is pushed D6" away.

lists.name: The Lion Padishah's Hammer
lists.style: Janissary block with jezzails advances behind a bombard-armed Brazen Bull, then counter-charges with the veteran Yuzbasi and the Mamluk.

lists.name: Knives of the Old Man
lists.style: Everything infiltrates or arrives from the edges; time-slipping assassins pick off key models while whirling Dervishes tie up the line.

lists.name: Expedition of the Porphyry Halls
lists.style: Two armoured Alchemists and Fris siege-gunners shoot from range while three Lions and a four-armed Homunculus hunt the flanks.
